scope: Design/verification contract, not test results or native simulation

cases.required: Continuous no-load CV behavior without damage/overheating; offline replacement and power-cycle restores normal operation without fuse/reset replacement.
cases.known: VS samples auxiliary at demagnetization end; source OVP enters UVLO reset only when sampled threshold exceeded.
cases.acceptance: Correlated native-compatible model or authorized later matched hardware establishes output/VDD peaks, minimum-load stability, input/loss power and actual component temperatures for continuous no-panel operation.
cases.remaining: No successful native model; no guaranteed dynamic output/power ceiling. Do not replace CV behavior with assumed OVP cycling.

cases.trigger: Hard output short, cold or from steady operation
cases.required: No damage or fuse replacement; bounded fault energy and temperatures; recovery after offline repair/power cycle.
cases.known: Auxiliary voltage tends to collapse, but leakage pickup and controller run-current minimum are unbounded; no automatic quantitative retry-power proof.
cases.acceptance: Bound actual pulses/peak/saturation/commutation and continuing VDD injection; demonstrate reset or another safe limiting state. Integrate winding/clamp/diode/MOS repetitive thermal stress without11W fault cap.
cases.remaining: Source-valid actual fault train, all relevant losses, minimum reset interval and physical confirmation.

cases.required: Source protection sequence must not overstress output/primary parts.
cases.known: TI specifies stop/reset for loss of feedback; static source thresholds are not dynamic spike bounds.
cases.acceptance: Enumerate each actual resistor/wire fault and bound output/drain/CS/VDD waveforms and latencies; approved later test matches physical graph.
cases.remaining: Native relevant model and waveform evidence unavailable.

cases.required: Control peak and terminate fault without relying on repeated avalanche or fuse replacement for a panel fault.
cases.known: 1.4–1.6V CS backup threshold,180–280ns leading-edge blanking and actual gate/delay conditions are distinct.
cases.acceptance: Validate maximum current and flux including leading-edge blanking, propagation, gate/MOS behavior, source line and saturation; pulse-energy scenarios are not current bounds.
cases.remaining: No guaranteed maximum dynamic fault current or fault pulse number.

cases.required: Inhibition while short persists; automatic source-defined reset/retry behavior without damage.
cases.acceptance: Actual power-on/hot-state check bounds any pre-inhibit pulse, VDD reset and current/temperatures; do not infer zero pulses from pin truth table alone.
cases.remaining: Exact sampling/power-up behavior not modeled by available28710 library.

cases.required: Passive thermal safety or independent source-valid automatic protection remains.
cases.known: Existing external NTC protection is lost; typical165C internal shutdown is not adequate whole-product protection.
cases.acceptance: Either validate complete passive normal/fault heat limits or qualify exact ECO-03 backup including source current/initial charge, full-temperature electrical interface, sensor lag/gradient and all new supply/component faults.
cases.remaining: ECO-03 is proposed/unapplied and startup/source/capacitor/lag conditions remain. No open-sensor finding closure claimed.

cases.required: Discharge/cooling/access criteria followed by reliable restart without manual reset/fuse change.
cases.known: Complete stored energy, backfeed and cooling can outlast a single outputRC clock.
cases.acceptance: Bind whole-assembly initial states, relevant component faults and line/ambient corners; actual user wait comes from authorized later electrical/cooling evidence with uncertainty.
cases.remaining: No approved user wait or physical recovery record;100s remains conditional electrical screen only.
